newsitem.title: USA: New England Business Q3 shr $0.45 vs $0.25.
newsitem.headline: New England Business Q3 shr $0.45 vs $0.25.

text.p: (In thousands of dollars, except per share data)
Three Months Ended Nine Months Ended
NOTES: Excluding the impact of one-time income and expense items in both years, third quarter earnings per share improved to $0.43 from last year's $0.26.

(a) Net income for quarter ended March 29, 1997 included an after-tax charge of $471,000 or $0.03 per share related to the discontinuation of the Kinko's retail initiative along with other cost actions plus an after-tax benefit of $301,000 or $0.02 per share related to the reversal of a portion of a Kinko's exit charge taken earlier this year.

Net income for the third quarter also reflected an after-tax benefit of $387,000 or $0.03 per share relating to a change in estimate of the income related to the curtailment of the company's defined benefit pension plan. Net income for the third quarter ended March 30, 1996 included $192,000 or $0.01 per share of after-tax charges and expenses relating to the implementation of a cost reduction program.

(b) Net income for the nine months ended March 29, 1997 included after-tax charges and expense of $3,591,000 or $0.26 per share related to the discontinuation of the Kinko initiative and other cost actions, and an after-tax benefit of $1,231,000 or $0.09 per share relating to the curtailment of the company's defined benefit pension plan. Net income for the same period included $6,413,000 or $0.43 per share of after-tax charges and expenses relating to the implementation of a cost reduction program.
Full company name is News England Business Service Inc.
